name: Arcane 1
description: Ancien Endormi réveillé libérant la puissance oubliée des ères pré-cosmiques remodelant temporairement les règles physiques du champ de bataille.

subject.archetype: Arcane 1 — Éveil Chthonien Legendary class faille_dimensionnelle

loadout.armor_outfit: Ancient ceremonial armor fused to wearer's body through dark ritual, shadowy fabric etched with independently shifting runic patterns casting purple light, living shadow tendrils writhing from shoulder guards with own consciousness, armor plates absorbing light instead of reflecting creating void patches with legendary cosmic materials and ancient craftsmanship that has become one with the wearer's being
loadout.arsenal: Massive ritual staff taller than wielder inscribed with independently rotating forbidden symbols, shadow-manipulation artifact orbiting hand like dark satellite with void energy tendrils connecting to body, cursed amulets chained to armor pulsating with green phosphor light emitting foul energy wisps The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's heal ability targeting self, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Hands pressed urgently against wounds as massive devastating golden regenerative energy wraps around injuries in cocoon of restorative light, visible flesh and armor mending in real time
attitude.emotion: Transcendent purpose — no longer merely fighting but reshaping the battlefield itself with every movement and breath

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Deep Void Purple
palette_names.role: primary_accent — shadow energy emanation and tentacle glow

palette_names.name: Bone White
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — skeletal remains and carved runes

palette_names.name: Eerie Green Phosphor
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — forbidden energy arcs and corruption

color_and_light.lighting_setup: aurum-plated frame with living energy flowing through ornate faction-specific patterns, border radiates golden glow, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Cinematic ultra-wide angle with dramatic depth layers — foreground devastation, character as glowing focal point, background cataclysm, sky and environment permanently altered

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield with ground splitting open in massive fissures as enormous shadow tentacles erupt from below, sky showing impossible geometry and wrongness human mind cannot process, ancient runes blazing on every surface as dimensions collapse, reality thinning and tearing at edges, thick oppressive atmosphere of supernatural dread
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Golden light flowing from within outward through every wound and crack, flesh healing before eyes, armor plates reforming, blood reversing flow as body rapidly repairs itself, Light radiating from character illuminating nearby area in warm golden tones, ground beneath blooming with new growth from overflow of restorative energy, Massive shadow tentacles erupting from cracked ground grasping at sky, dimensional rifts tearing open revealing impossible non-Euclidean geometry with wrong colors, floating forbidden runes spinning violently in dark purple energy maelstrom, skeletal remains rattling and rising from earth, void essence fog rolling across ground like creeping tsunami
